chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ibn Faddal, from Ibn Bukayr, who said:
I asked Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) about the woman whose husband dies; can she perform Hajj? He said, 'Yes,' and she can move from one house to another house.

key_terms.مِنْ مَنْزِلٍ إِلَى مَنْزِلٍ: from one house to another house

ai.seo_question: Can a widow perform Hajj and move between houses?
ai.summary: In this narration from al-Kafi, Imam al-Sadiq (AS) clarifies that a widow who has consummated her marriage is permitted to perform Hajj during her Iddah period, provided she travels and resides in a place of her choice rather than being confined to her late husband's home. This ruling highlights the distinction between the general waiting period and the specific residential restrictions, affirming her autonomy in fulfilling religious duties while maintaining the sanctity of the Iddah.

en.sarwar: 14. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from ibn Faddal from ibn Bukayr who has said the following: “

I once asked abu Ibrahim, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, about the case of a woman whose husband dies; if she can perform al-Hajj. He (the Imam) said, ‘Yes, she can do so and she can move from one house to another house.’”
